This patch registers the deflate-iaa deflate compression algorithm and
hooks it up to the IAA hardware using the 'fixed' compression mode
introduced in the previous patch.
Because the IAA hardware has a 4k history-window limitation
buffers <= 4k
column2: or that have been compressed using a <= 4k history

column1: window
column2: are technically compliant with the deflate spec

column1: for a window of up to 32k.  Because of this limitation
mode deflate algorithm is given its own algorithm name
With this change
column2: the deflate-iaa crypto algorithm is registered and

column1: operational
column2: and compression and decompression operations are fully

column1: enabled following the successful binding of the first IAA workqueue
to the iaa_crypto sub-driver.
when there are no IAA workqueues bound to the driver
algorithm can be unregistered by removing the module.
A new iaa_crypto 'verify_compress' driver attribute is also added
allowing the user to toggle compression verification.  If set
compress will be internally decompressed and the contents verified
returning error codes if unsuccessful.  This can be toggled with 0/1:
echo 0 > /sys/bus/dsa/drivers/crypto/verify_compress
The default setting is '1' - verify all compresses.
The verify_compress value setting at the time the algorithm is
registered is captured in the algorithm's crypto_ctx and used for all
compresses when using the algorithm.
